title: So-so-quality
text: So-so-quality. We were disappointed in the quality of these. We've already had several come apart. For a product that kids may be using they really need to be better. They also seem kind of sparse. It is hard just to seperate them. The colors are fine. They just seem inexpensive and not particularly well made. You get a lot for what you pay and I guess you get what you pay for. If you want something really cheap and quick, they can still be an okay option but don't forget great quality.
